title: AI in Your Editor
subtitle: Coding with an assistant at your side
description: Opening session of the new Coding Café year. Working with an AI assistant inside your IDE: what it does and what it doesn't, getting set up with Copilot in VS Code, staying in control of what it writes, and keeping research software FAIR.
speaker: Özgün Balaban

title: AI assisted coding: examples and discussion
description: A practical tour of coding with an AI in the loop from AI-assisted to AI-driven. There will be examples and a discussion.
speaker: Özgün Balaban

title: Version Control: Working with Git
description: A short demo on version control using Git. Some practical tips, best practices...
speaker: Özgün Balaban

title: Building Better Research Software Together
description:
Do you write code as part of your research, analyses, or daily work, but feel unsure about the "right way" to structure things?
You're not alone!
In this Coding Café session, we will explore simple and practical habits that make programming easier, more organized, and more enjoyable.
speaker: Özgün Balaban
